description: Denies a Read, or a read-like Bash command (cat, head, tail…), whose target file content carries secret-shaped data, before it reaches the cloud model — see privacy_egress.py. A mod (secrets-hold/register.tsx) holds a `Read` of a flagged file in a band above the prompt with one button per outcome — add the allowlist pragma on the flagged lines, delegate to the local model (only when its server answers), or deny; an unanswered hold falls back to the guard's deny, and the Bash channel keeps the deny.
